de.abas.ceks.jedp.query

Interface EDPQueryResult

  • All Superinterfaces:
    EDPQueryResultFieldSet
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    EDPQuery

    public interface EDPQueryResult
extends EDPQueryResultFieldSet
    Provides the interface to traverse through EDP result sets.

      • getLastRecord

        boolean getLastRecord()
        Moves the record cursor to the next record. Afterwards the fields of this record can be retrieved.

        If there has not been read the completey query result, this occurs with this operation. This means, that with larger results this operation can cause significant delay.

        Execution of this method can be interrupted by callingbreakQuery in a second thread.

        Returns:
        moving the record cursor to the last record of the result was successful. All data has been read by the JEDP client.
        Since:
        abas Version 10, EDP Version 2.0
        See Also:
        getNextRecord(), getPrevRecord(), getFirstRecord(), getRecordRelative(int), getRecordAbsolute(int), breakQuery()

      • getRecordRelative

        boolean getRecordRelative(int moveCount)
        Moves the record cursor to the record addressed in relative manner. Afterwards the fields of this record can be retrieved. If moveCount is positive, the record counter is being moved forward, else backward. If the new cursor position is greater than the number of records read from server so far, the required records will be fetched.

        Execution of this method can be interrupted by callingbreakQuery in a second thread if it is fetching missing records.

        Parameters:
        moveCount - Positive or negative number of rows to move the record cursor relative to the current record.
        Returns:
        moving the record cursor by the moveCount number of record was successful
        See Also:
        getNextRecord(), getPrevRecord(), getFirstRecord(), getLastRecord(), getRecordAbsolute(int), breakQuery()

      • getRecordAbsolute

        boolean getRecordAbsolute(int recordNumber)
        Moves the record cursor to the record addressed by the record number as absolute position. If the new cursor position is greater than the number of records read from server so far, the required records will be fetched.

        Execution of this method can be interrupted by callingbreakQuery in a second thread if it is fetching missing records.

        Parameters:
        recordNumber - number of the record to position on
        Returns:
        moving the record cursor to the recordNumber position was successful
        Since:
        abas Version 10, EDP Version 2.0
        See Also:
        getNextRecord(), getPrevRecord(), getFirstRecord(), getLastRecord(), getRecordRelative(int), breakQuery()

      • getRecordCount

        int getRecordCount()
        Provides the number of records fetched from the server so far. This number increases during traversal of a query result according to successive fetches. The true number of records in a query result cannot be retrieved in advance, only an approximate estimation value using (getRecordTotal(). The defininte number of records in a result is not available until the result is fetched comletely, e.g. by calling getLastRecord.

        Returns:
        number of records fetched so far
        Since:
        abas Version 10, EDP Version 2.0

      • getRecordTotal

        int getRecordTotal()
        Provides the total number of records in the query result. This value is not necessarily exact, since it is being derived from internal statistical information for data queries. This value can changing during traversal of the query result.

        If there is no value known for the total number of records, 0 is returned.

        Returns:
        approximate number of records in the query result
        Since:
        abas Version 2010r1, EDP Version 3.29

      • getRecordNumber

        int getRecordNumber()
        Provides the record number of the current record, i.e. the position of the record cursor.
        Returns:
        number of current record
        Since:
        abas Version 10, EDP Version 2.0

      • breakQuery

        void breakQuery()
        Interrupts query processing. If the client is fetching data and just waiting for the server response, this method interrupts server processing if called in a second thread. If the client is not currently waiting for the server to respond, this methods terminates the result set and any try to fetch more data leads to "end of result" state. There is no response for this method.

      • getResultTable

        List<EDPQueryResultFieldSet> getResultTable()
        Provides the table rows of the current record, if available. The table rows are available for data records which have a table part with at least one row in it. It must be requested by setting DataRecordQuery.setTableFieldList(de.abas.ceks.jedp.FieldList) in the query descriptor object before execution of the query.
        Returns:
        a list with the table rows of the current record or null if none available.
        Since:
        abas Version 2017r4, EDP Version 3.51
        See Also:
        DataRecordQuery.setTableFieldList(de.abas.ceks.jedp.FieldList), DataRecordQuery.setRowSet(de.abas.ceks.jedp.EDPRowSet)
